# avo

- **Commit:** `8cd34c2f7c04d439941e5c70c3bbfb460e26dec8`
- **Licence:** MIT

## Why we vendor it

Avo is an MIT notch voice agent that acts through the user's own apps. It has low traction (1 star when checked on 2026-11-24), so we treat it as a source of **small, readable pieces and patterns**, not as proven code.

| Upstream file | What we take | Belay destination | Feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Avo/Tools/SpotifyTools.swift` | Spotify control (play/pause/skip, now-playing) via AppleScript | **Adapt** at `apps/mac/Belay/MacBridge/NowPlaying.swift` | B1, B2, J3 |
| `Avo/Notch/DictationWave.swift` | Listening waveform view (33 lines) | **Adapt** at `apps/mac/Belay/Voice/` | C1 |

**Patterns (not code):** Avo's "anything that sends, creates or deletes shows an editable card first" rule is the model for Belay's J4 edit-before-it-happens cards. Its tool list (Messages, Calendar, Reminders, Notes, Finder, Spotify, Drive) is the menu for J3.

**Rules:** files here stay byte-identical to upstream. Adapted copies carry a header:
`// Adapted from Avo (MIT), <upstream path> @ 8cd34c2f. See third_party/avo/.`
